command: set -euo pipefail; serial=$(adb devices | awk 'NR>1 && $2=="device" {print $1; exit}'); test -n "$serial"; test "$(adb -s "$serial" shell getprop ro.product.model | tr -d '\r')" = "SM-S906B"; adb -s "$serial" shell am force-stop io.blueeye; sleep 1; adb -s "$serial" shell am start -W -n io.blueeye/.MainActivity >/dev/null; sleep 2; test -n "$(adb -s "$serial" shell pidof io.blueeye | tr -d '\r')"; echo P3_V59_APP_RELAUNCHED_SCAN_RESET
